Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue address?
Choices:
A. A specific workflow or pipeline phase — name it. (RECOMMENDED)
B. A specific script or feature — name it.
C. Documentation — name the page or topic.
Q2: What outcome should the change achieve?
Choices:
A. Fix a reproducible problem — describe what happens and what should happen instead. (RECOMMENDED)
B. Add a capability — describe the expected behavior.
C. Improve an existing quality, such as speed or reliability — state the goal and how to assess it.
